items.layout: Rendered and visually inspected all eight main-manuscript pages, initial full-page views and final full contact sheets, with final pages 1, 4 and 5 reinspected at full page after changes. Compared approved Higgott rendered page 1 and both preambles: 11pt, letter, .82in margins, formal title/abstract/headline table, narrative sections, artifact table and references are comparable. Tables, equation, figure and long filenames remain legible without clipping or overlaps. pdffonts reports embedded scalable Type1/CID TrueType fonts; no Type3 fonts. Final render evidence in provenance/review-render/.
items.headline_and_tolerance: Page 1 states partial replication, positive phase gain and enlargement penalty at alpha 1.5204, and common crossover at alpha 2.0102 without source-to-replication sign reversal. Inspected source Figure 3.2 and extracted markers independently before computation. Eight signed headline contrasts and twelve supporting dual-rail comparisons are consistently defined; 10/12 source comparisons lie inside deterministic extraction envelopes, two extended-arm values outside. Requested fix to ambiguous directional-only match caption was applied: match now explicitly includes envelope inclusion and excludes a decimal-rounding verdict. Shared Table 2 caption clearly applies precision unavailable, rounding withheld, scope limited to every row. Final section 4.1 declares inferred uniform amplitude grid, not source-code knowledge. Extraction envelope is not sampling confidence or source solver precision. Finite-photon/solver check limits and floating-point certificates are explicit.
items.citations: All five cited reference keys have bibliography entries and in-text uses. Denys title, institution, defense date, pinned author-hosted thesis and relevant page/equation references agree with independently read source. Method citations support SDP recovery/CVXPY/Clarabel/SCS; provenance/citation_audit.json accurately limits those readings to metadata/abstracts and does not imply independent proof of this quantum derivation. References and clickable URLs visually inspected on page 8.
items.ledgers: Compared all five availability rows and ten compliance rows in rendered pages 6-7 with provenance/availability.json and provenance/compliance.json and generated row inputs. Study navigation targets github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/master/formalization/denys-bosonic-pauli/ with correct existing local paths; long editable .tex filename wraps legibly. Appendix explicitly warns new master links will not resolve until merge and directs users to PR current-commit links. Computation revision 54ccd6bab1e53c31baccbce7745dff1eba44e743 and author-source revision are immutable links. Remote download/hash verification and PR publication are outside this review and remain parent delivery steps.
items.independence_limits: Reviewer independently read source definitions/loss/recovery normalization and rendered source Figure 3.2, extracted source vector markers before viewing primary results, and reviewed final rendered manuscript against those observations. Reviewer did not author or run the primary optimizer or independent Fock optimizer, and relies on the separate computation review plus recorded outputs for their numerical validation. Both computational routes share thesis definitions, objective and CVXPY; no original generating code/settings were obtained. This is bounded selected-condition replication, not full-thesis replication, optimum verification, original solver-error certification, or external scientific peer review.
